open_points.subject: flow:run_effect_with_approval / Step 4 Approve
open_points.text: State 4 says: "The request is sent at once, in the owner's request (A10 rule 3)"; A10 rule 1 says an approved request with a different `request_digest` "is no authority for this send ... under a grant when one applies, otherwise requests a new approval".
open_points.question: After the owner approves, if the rebuilt request no longer matches that approval and no standing grant applies, must this approve call still send, or must it create/wait for a new approval?
options: Re-check authority; if digest mismatches and no grant, do not send and wait for a new approval.
Send only if a matching grant exists; otherwise wait.
open_points.default_guess: Re-check authority and do not send on mismatch without grant; return to awaiting approval.

open_points.subject: flow:start_and_recover_kernel / Step 3 check_installed_instances
open_points.text: State 4 step 3 names only: "no credential header has ... the name of a required header of its instance (A09 rule 1)"; A09 rule 1 also requires start refusal when the credential header matches "a header the kernel sets itself" (`host`, `accept-encoding`, `content-type`, `content-length`).
open_points.question: Which module/step performs the credential-header-vs-kernel-set-header start check, and what exact refusal outcome is returned when it fails?
open_points.default_guess: bindings.check_installed_instances performs it and start stops with that check named.
